hotel_name: Fortune Park, East Delhi - Member Itc Hotels' Group

positive_snippets:
Wehad a wonderful experience at Hotel Fortune East Delhi. The housekeeping was excellent, and the rooms were cleaned daily, making our stay very comfortable.

The room service was prompt and well-organized. A special mention to Chef Harikesh who prepared his signature dishes, Laal Maas and Chole, especially for us. The taste was outstanding and truly memorable.

The buffet dinner was delicious and offered a wide variety of dishes

Overall, it was a pleasant and satisfying stay. I highly recommend this hotel for its great service, cleanliness, and amazing food. Looking forward to visiting again! Excellent hospitality. Appreciate the service of Mr.Sandeep and Mr. Pankajabd Sakshi

I went to ITC Fortune in Vivek Vihar. The food there is excellent for dinner; it's even better than the food I've had at The Leela, many times tastier. And the best part is that there was a chef who was going to every table, and he came to my table too and served me food according to my preferences. You rarely see this kind of service. He served me exactly what I wanted, and I felt compelled to give my feedback. If I ever go out to eat again, it will be at ITC Fortune Delhi, Vivek Vihar. I met a chef there who is truly remarkable, and the best thing is that he even let me try one of his specialty dishes, his signature dish. I thank ITC Fortune, where there is such a humble chef, Mr. Sharma. Thank you so much, Mr. Sharma.

I had a very pleasant stay and was impressed with the overall quality of the hotel.
• The rooms are well maintained and almost fully furnished, offering a comfortable stay.
• The hotel provides a wide range of facilities. The gym, in particular, is well equipped with all essential fitness equipment.
• The food served was consistently fresh and tasty.
• The staff members are courteous, polite, and highly supportive.
I would like to extend a special mention to Mr. Abdesh for his attentiveness and helpful attitude throughout my stay. His service truly enhanced the overall experience.
